title: 致电 GP 诊所抢当天号看久咳
titleEn: Calling the GP clinic for a same-day appointment
scene: 周五早上 8 点刚过，你已经咳了快两个星期，晚上咳得睡不好，想今天就看上家庭医生（GP）。你打给常去的 Prospect 那家家庭诊所（medical centre）。前台 Kerry 很热情，但一大早电话多，她语速快、缩略多，会说“今天号很满”、“只有 on-the-day 号”、“可以排 cancellation list 或者做 telehealth”，还会提到收费：是不是 bulk billing、自付多少、Medicare 退多少。
你的目标：① 说清楚自己是老病人、症状和持续时间，争取今天的号；② 听懂几个选项（当天号、候补名单、电话问诊、下周固定医生）并做出选择；③ 问清楚费用、要不要提前到、诊所会不会短信确认。

facts.v: 你是这家诊所的老病人（existing patient），上次来是今年五月
咳嗽快两周，晚上加重，没发烧
今天 11:40，Dr Patel，standard consult，提前 5–10 分钟到
$90 private fee，Medicare 当场退约 $43，自付约 $47

vocab.zh: 家庭医生 / 家庭诊所
vocab.ex: I rang the medical centre to see a GP today.

vocab.zh: 当天放出的号（早上开放预约）
vocab.ex: We release our on-the-day appointments at eight.

vocab.zh: 候补名单（有人取消就通知你）
vocab.ex: I can pop you on the cancellation list.
Would a telehealth appointment suit you?

vocab.zh: 老病人（之前在这里看过）
vocab.ex: Are you an existing patient with us?

vocab.zh: 直接向 Medicare 收费、病人不用自付
自己掏的钱（扣掉报销后）
vocab.ex: So I'm about forty-seven out of pocket.
The rebate goes straight back onto your card.

vocab.zh: 普通 / 长时间问诊（约 15 / 30 分钟）
vocab.ex: Is it just the one issue, so a standard consult?
I've had a hacking cough for nearly two weeks.
It keeps me up at night.

listening.en: Morning, Prospect Family Practice, Kerry speaking, how can I help?
listening.sound: Morning 前面的 Good 被吞掉；Kerry speaking 很快，要抓住名字和诊所名
listening.zh: 早上好，Prospect 家庭诊所，我是 Kerry，有什么可以帮你？
listening.reply: Hi Kerry, I'm hoping to see a GP today if possible.

listening.en: Are you an existing patient with us, love?
listening.sound: with us → “with-us”连读；love 是前台常用的亲切称呼，不用在意
listening.zh: 你之前在我们这儿看过吗？
listening.reply: Yes, I am. I saw Dr Patel back in May.

listening.en: She's pretty chockers today, to be honest – I've only got the one on-the-day left, at eleven-forty.
listening.sound: chockers → “chock-ers”，= 满满的；the one … left = 只剩一个；eleven-forty = 11:40
listening.zh: 说实话她今天很满，当天号只剩一个，11:40。
listening.reply: Eleven-forty is perfect. I'll take it.

listening.en: Otherwise I can pop you on the cancellation list, or she does telehealth after four.
listening.sound: pop you on → “pop-ya-on”，= 把你加到；after four = 四点以后
listening.zh: 不然我可以把你放进候补名单，或者她四点后有电话问诊。
listening.reply: Thanks, but I'd rather come in so she can have a listen to my chest.

listening.en: Just a heads-up, we don't bulk bill adults – it's ninety for a standard, and you'll get about forty-three back on the spot.
listening.sound: heads-up = 提前告诉你；bulk bill 要听懂；on the spot = 当场
listening.zh: 先提醒你，成人不 bulk bill，普通问诊 $90，当场能退约 $43。
listening.reply: No worries. So I'm about forty-seven out of pocket?

listening.en: If you could rock up five, ten minutes early, that'd be great. You'll get a text confirmation shortly.
listening.sound: rock up = 到场；five, ten minutes = 五到十分钟；shortly = 一会儿
listening.zh: 麻烦提前五到十分钟到。很快会收到确认短信。
listening.reply: Will do. Thanks so much for your help.

speech.topic: 我在澳洲是怎么看家庭医生的
paragraphs: When I first moved to Adelaide, I didn't really understand how the health system worked. Back home, if I felt sick, I would just go straight to a hospital. Here, the first step is almost always a GP, which is a family doctor. If you need a specialist, the GP writes you a referral.

Finding a good GP took me a while. I tried a few medical centres near my place. In the end, I chose one that is close to my kids' school and has online booking. Now I see the same doctor most of the time, so she knows my history and I don't have to explain everything again.

Booking an appointment can still be tricky. Popular doctors are often booked out for a week or two. So I've learnt a few tricks. If I need to see someone on the same day, I call right at eight o'clock, when the clinic releases its on-the-day appointments. If there's nothing left, I ask to go on the cancellation list, or I book a telehealth call.

I've also learnt to ask about the fee before I go. Some clinics bulk bill, so you don't pay anything. Others charge a private fee, and Medicare pays part of it back. The gap can be forty or fifty dollars, so it's good to know.
My biggest tip is this: don't be shy on the phone. If the receptionist talks too fast, just ask them to slow down. They are usually very friendly and happy to help.
speech.zh: 刚来阿德莱德时我不懂这里的医疗体系，以前生病直接去医院，而这里第一步几乎都是看家庭医生 GP，需要专科时由 GP 开转诊。我试了几家诊所，最后选了离孩子学校近、能网上预约的一家，现在基本固定看同一位医生，她了解我的病史。约号仍然不容易：好医生常常一两周都约满了，所以我想当天看病就八点准时打电话抢当天号，没有的话就排候补或者约电话问诊。我也学会了事先问费用：有的诊所 bulk bill 不用付钱，有的收私人费用、Medicare 退一部分，差价可能四五十块。最重要的建议是：电话里别害羞，前台说太快就请她慢一点，他们通常都很乐意帮忙。

patterns.en: In the end, I chose ___ because ___.
patterns.zh: 最后我选了……，因为……（讲做决定的过程）

patterns.en: If I need to ___, I ___ right at ___.
patterns.zh: 如果我需要……，我就在……准时……（分享小技巧）
我最大的建议是：……（演讲收尾）

lines.en: Morning, Prospect Family Practice, Kerry speaking, how can I help?
lines.zh: 早上好，Prospect 家庭诊所，我是 Kerry，有什么可以帮你？

lines.en: Hi Kerry. I was hoping to get in to see a GP today, if possible.
lines.zh: 你好 Kerry，如果可以的话，我想今天看一下家庭医生。

lines.en: Sure, I'll see what I can do. Are you an existing patient with us, love?
lines.zh: 好的，我看看能怎么安排。你之前在我们这儿看过吗？

lines.en: Yes, I am. I usually see Dr Patel. The last time was back in May, I think.
lines.zh: 看过，我一般看 Dr Patel，上次大概是五月。

lines.en: Lovely. Can I just grab your date of birth to bring up your file?
lines.zh: 好的。能告诉我你的出生日期吗？我调一下你的档案。

lines.en: Sure, it's the twelfth of March, nineteen eighty-seven.
Yep, got you. Still at fourteen Wattle Street? And what's going on for you today?
lines.zh: 嗯，找到了。还住在 Wattle Street 14 号吗？今天是哪里不舒服？

lines.en: Yes, same address. I've had a hacking cough for nearly two weeks. It's worse at night and it keeps me up. No fever, though.
lines.zh: 对，地址没变。我咳得很厉害快两个星期了，晚上更严重，睡不好。不过没发烧。

lines.en: Oh, you poor thing, there's a lot of that going round at the moment. Look, Dr Patel's pretty chockers today, to be honest – I've only got the one on-the-day left, at eleven-forty. Otherwise I can pop you on the cancellation list, or she does telehealth after four.
lines.zh: 哎呀，真难受，最近很多人都这样。说实话 Dr Patel 今天很满，当天号只剩一个，11:40。不然可以把你放进候补名单，或者她四点后有电话问诊。

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? I caught eleven-forty, but not the rest.
lines.zh: 不好意思，能再说慢一点吗？我听到了 11:40，后面没听清。

lines.en: Course, sorry, I'm going a hundred miles an hour this morning! So: one spot at eleven-forty today. Or I put you on a waiting list in case someone cancels. Or she can ring you after four for a phone appointment.
lines.zh: 当然，抱歉，我今天早上说话太快了！就是：今天 11:40 有一个号；或者把你放进候补名单，有人取消就通知你；或者她四点后给你打电话问诊。

lines.en: Thanks. I'll take the eleven-forty, please. I'd rather come in so she can listen to my chest.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我要 11:40 的号。我还是想当面看，让医生听听我的肺。

lines.en: Good call. Is it just the one issue? If so, I'll book a standard consult.
lines.zh: 好主意。就这一个问题吗？是的话我就约普通问诊。

lines.en: Just the cough, yes. Can I ask how much it'll be? Do you bulk bill?
lines.zh: 就是咳嗽。请问费用多少？你们 bulk bill 吗？

lines.en: Just a heads-up, we only bulk bill under-sixteens and concession card holders. For adults it's ninety for a standard, and you'll get about forty-three back from Medicare on the spot, as long as we've got your card details.
lines.zh: 先提醒一下，我们只给 16 岁以下和持优惠卡的人 bulk bill。成人普通问诊 $90，只要我们有你的卡信息，Medicare 当场退约 $43。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you mean I pay ninety, and I get about forty-three back straight away? So I'm about forty-seven out of pocket?
lines.zh: 确认一下，你是说我付 $90，马上能退回大约 $43？所以我自付大约 $47？

lines.en: Spot on. The rebate goes straight back onto your debit card, usually within a minute or two.
lines.zh: 完全正确。报销款会直接退回你的借记卡，一般一两分钟就到。

lines.en: Great. Is there anything I need to bring?
lines.zh: 好的。我需要带什么吗？

lines.en: Just your Medicare card. And if you could rock up five, ten minutes early, that'd be great – we're running a bit behind already. Oh, and if you've got any cold symptoms, pop a mask on when you come in, there's some at the front desk.
lines.zh: 带上 Medicare 卡就行。麻烦提前五到十分钟到，我们已经有点晚点了。哦对，如果有感冒症状，进来的时候戴个口罩，前台有。

lines.en: No worries, I'll wear a mask. Is my mobile still on file? It's oh-four-nine-one, five-seven-oh, two-three-eight.
lines.zh: 没问题，我会戴口罩。你们那里还是我的手机号吗？是 0491 570 238。

lines.en: Yep, that's the one we've got. You'll get a text confirmation shortly. If you need to cancel, just reply C to the text.
lines.zh: 对，就是这个号。你很快会收到确认短信。如果要取消，回复字母 C 就行。

lines.en: Perfect. And if the cough gets a lot worse over the weekend, what should I do?
lines.zh: 好的。如果周末咳嗽严重了很多，我该怎么办？

lines.en: Good question. If it's after hours, there's a home-visit GP service – the number's on our website. But if you're struggling to breathe or you've got chest pain, don't muck around, call triple zero.
lines.zh: 问得好。如果是下班时间，有上门看诊的 GP 服务，电话在我们网站上。但如果呼吸困难或者胸口痛，别拖，直接打 000。

lines.en: Got it. Thanks so much for squeezing me in, Kerry.
lines.zh: 明白了。非常感谢你帮我挤出一个号，Kerry。

lines.en: No worries at all. Hope you feel better soon. See you at eleven-forty!
lines.zh: 不客气。希望你早日好起来，11:40 见！

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that a bit slower? I didn't quite catch it.
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点吗？我没完全听清。

rescue.en: Sorry, was that eleven-forty or eleven-fourteen?
Could you spell the doctor's name for me, please?
rescue.zh: 能帮我拼一下医生的名字吗？

rescue.en: Just to confirm, how much will I be out of pocket?
rescue.zh: 确认一下，我自己要付多少钱？

rescue.en: Could you send me a text with the time and the fee, please?
rescue.zh: 能把时间和费用发短信给我吗？

checklist: 我能用一两句话说清自己是老病人、症状是什么、持续多久
我听懂了 chockers、on-the-day、cancellation list、telehealth 这几个选项
我至少用了一次礼貌追问（说慢一点 / Just to confirm…）
我问清了是否 bulk bill、自付多少、Medicare 退多少
我确认了预约时间、要提前到、要带 Medicare 卡，以及短信确认
我知道周末加重该找谁、什么情况要打 000
